subject: maths
title: Random Variables and Expectation
welcome_lead: Quantify uncertainty: compute expectation and variance for random variables.
meta_desc: Maths adventure on discrete random variables, E(X), Var(X) and distributions.
final_note: E(X) is the long-run average, Var(X) the spread squared!

options: (3x + 3)(2x + 3), by trying to factorise as a quadratic.
